title: Future Goals
text:
I'm graduating in April 2026 with a clear sense of where I want to go, not just professionally, but personally. Here's what I'm working towards.




Short term
Business analyst in the gaming industry
My goal after graduating is to work as a business analyst, ideally within the gaming industry. It's a sector I find genuinely exciting: fast-moving, data-driven, and creatively ambitious. I want to be part of a team where analytical thinking shapes real product decisions.


Location
Working abroad in London
London is one of Europe's biggest hubs for tech and gaming companies. Moving there after graduation is a goal I'm actively working towards. The exposure, the network, and the pace of the industry there is exactly the environment I want to grow in early in my career.







Summer 2026
Explore beyond Europe
Before stepping into the workforce full-time, I want to take the summer after graduation to travel, not just within Europe, but across different continents. Experiencing new cultures, places, and perspectives is something I believe makes you a better thinker and a better professional.




Asia
Top of the list. Japan and Southeast Asia are places I've wanted to visit for years.


Americas
Experiencing a completely different culture and pace of life across the Atlantic.


New experiences
Meeting people, trying things outside my comfort zone, and coming back ready to work.


Places on the list


















Graduate
April 2026
Complete my BSc in Business Studies at Dublin City University.





Travel
Summer 2026
Spend the summer travelling across continents, Asia, the Americas, and wherever else takes my interest.





Move to London
Late 2026
Relocate to London and begin my career as a business analyst in the gaming or tech industry.

title: Aleksander Lupa
text:
About me

I'm a final-year Business Studies student at Dublin City University, specialising in Business Analytics. I'm passionate about the point where business questions meet technical problem-solving, using data to clarify what's happening, why it's happening, and what to do next.
My toolkit spans Python (Pandas/NumPy), SQL/MySQL, Power BI/Tableau, Excel, and web fundamentals including HTML/CSS. I also have hands-on experience designing and building multiple websites using WordPress, giving me a practical understanding of how design and content come together for real audiences. I enjoy the full analytical cycle: framing the business problem, building tidy data models, testing assumptions, and communicating insights that drive real decisions.
Outside of work and college, I'm a dedicated bodybuilder. The discipline and consistency that the sport demands carries into everything else I do.
